The test `['pandas.tests.indexes.test_range.TestRangeIndex.test_constructor_range()']` failed.
The test looks like:

```python
119 :     def test_constructor_range(self):
120 : 
121 :         msg = "Value needs to be a scalar value, was type <class 'range'>"
122 :         with pytest.raises(TypeError, match=msg):
123 :             result = RangeIndex(range(1, 5, 2))
124 : 
125 :         result = RangeIndex.from_range(range(1, 5, 2))
126 :         expected = RangeIndex(1, 5, 2)
127 :         tm.assert_index_equal(result, expected, exact=True)
129 :         result = RangeIndex.from_range(range(5, 6))
130 :         expected = RangeIndex(5, 6, 1)
131 :         tm.assert_index_equal(result, expected, exact=True)
133 :         # an invalid range
134 :         result = RangeIndex.from_range(range(5, 1))
135 :         expected = RangeIndex(0, 0, 1)
136 :         tm.assert_index_equal(result, expected, exact=True)
138 :         result = RangeIndex.from_range(range(5))
139 :         expected = RangeIndex(0, 5, 1)
140 :         tm.assert_index_equal(result, expected, exact=True)
142 :         result = Index(range(1, 5, 2))
143 :         expected = RangeIndex(1, 5, 2)
144 :         tm.assert_index_equal(result, expected, exact=True)
146 :         with pytest.raises(
147 :             ValueError,
148 :             match="Incorrect `dtype` passed: expected signed integer, received float64",
149 :         ):
150 :             Index(range(1, 5, 2), dtype="float64") # error occurred here
```

It failed with the following error message and call stack:

```
E           TypeError: Invalid to pass a non-int64 dtype to RangeIndex
>           Index(range(1, 5, 2), dtype="float64")
pandas/tests/indexes/test_range.py:150: 
pandas/core/indexes/base.py:299: in __new__
pandas/core/indexes/base.py:299: in __new__
    return RangeIndex.from_range(data, dtype=dtype, name=name)
pandas/core/indexes/range.py:146: in from_range
    cls._validate_dtype(dtype)

>           raise TypeError("Invalid to pass a non-int64 dtype to RangeIndex")
pandas/core/indexes/range.py:172: TypeError
```
